question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
-- Final query: distinct drivers who meet the criteria, sorted by surname then forename
WITH driver_season_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           TRY_CAST(CAST(is_first_drive_of_season AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) as is_first,
           TRY_CAST(CAST(is_final_drive_of_season AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) as is_final
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_season_summary AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN is_first = 1 THEN constructor_id END) as first_constructor,
           MAX(CASE WHEN is_final = 1 THEN constructor_id END) as last_constructor,
           MIN(first_round) as min_round,
           MAX(last_round) as max_round
    FROM driver_season_drives
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname
FROM driver_season_summary dss
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = dss.driver_id
WHERE dss.min_round != dss.max_round
   AND dss.first_constructor = dss.last_constructor
   AND dss.first_constructor != -1
ORDER BY d.forename, d.surname

{"sql": "-- Get all qualifying driver-seasons with driver and constructor names
WITH driver_season_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           TRY_CAST(CAST(is_first_drive_of_season AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) as is_first,
           TRY_CAST(CAST(is_final_drive_of_season AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) as is_final
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_season_summary AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN is_first = 1 THEN constructor_id END) as first_constructor,
           MAX(CASE WHEN is_final = 1 THEN constructor_id END) as last_constructor,
           MIN(first_round) as min_round,
           MAX(last_round) as max_round
    FROM driver_season_drives
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
)
SELECT dss.year, d.forename, d.surname, c.name as constructor_name,
       dss.first_constructor, dss.min_round, dss.max_round
FROM driver_season_summary dss
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = dss.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id = dss.first_constructor
WHERE dss.min_round != dss.max_round
   AND dss.first_constructor = dss.last_constructor
   AND dss.first_constructor != -1
ORDER BY dss.year, d.forename, d.surname", "preview_rows": 50}
